_note: Per-enemy item priority overrides + lane matchup difficulty. Patch 26.8 / Season 16.
_purpose: Loaded by coaches to refine item recommendations beyond generic threat analysis.

_format.enemy_item_overrides: ChampName → item to prioritize + which slot + why
_format.slot_override: 0-indexed build slot to replace. -1 = add as 6th item or shift build.
_format.adc_lane_matchup: difficulty 1-5, note for coaching, key mechanic to respect

Draven.priority_note: Rushing Axes deal bonus AD damage. Don't trade level 1-2. Respect his all-in at any time - he has no weak window. Play for gank setup only.
Draven.key_mechanic: Spinning Axes Q - he drops them on stack if you poke him off. Force him to walk away from axes to deny gold.

Caitlyn.priority_note: She outranges you on most ADCs. Avoid her traps at all costs - free headshots. Priority: match her wave control and farm safely to items.
Caitlyn.key_mechanic: Trap W + headshot combo - step on trap = free trade lost. Zone control at objective approaches.

Jinx.priority_note: Weak pre-6 without passive. Force trades before she gets items. Avoid letting her reach 3 items - passive reset snowball becomes unkillable.
Jinx.key_mechanic: Passive Get Excited! - never leave her with a free reset target nearby. Reset windows are her power spike.

Jhin.priority_note: 4th shot crits but is telegraphed. Play unpredictably in lane. He has no mobility - punish with hard engage at 4th shot window.
Jhin.key_mechanic: 4th auto + W root - sidestep the W root to deny his combo chain.

Tristana.priority_note: Explosive Charge E stacks on you passively - trade when she hasn't stacked E. Deny her tower resets with early all-ins before she hits level 7.
Tristana.key_mechanic: Rocket Jump W reset - if she's fed, assume she will all-in on any kill target. Don't fight unless you can one-shot her.

Vayne.priority_note: Weak early, strong late. Deny CS early and force her behind in gold. She can't fight back level 1-5. Win lane phase before she scales.
Vayne.key_mechanic: Silver Bolts W - avoid extended 3-hit trades. Trade short, disengage before 3rd stack.

Miss Fortune.priority_note: E Double Up bounces off minions - never stand behind a low-HP minion. Bullet Time R is the fight ender - disrupt or dodge it at all costs.
Miss Fortune.key_mechanic: Bullet Time R - sidestep or break LoS. Never cluster with allies near her angle.

Sivir.priority_note: Spell Shield E blocks one ability - drain it with a low-value ability before committing your CC or kill combo.
Sivir.key_mechanic: Spell Shield E - bait it before engaging. Team movespeed R ult makes her teamfight dangerous.

Ezreal.priority_note: Safe but low damage early. Push him off farm with poke - he can't fight without his Q hits stacking. Punish blink E cooldown (18s) windows.
Ezreal.key_mechanic: Arcane Shift E - time your engage for when E is on CD. He has no answer for hard engage on E CD.

Xayah.priority_note: Feather root range is deceptively long - track her feather placement. Featherstorm R invincibility is her escape - don't waste CC into it.
Xayah.key_mechanic: Bladecaller E root - never walk through feather trail paths. Root from unexpected angles.

Kog'Maw.priority_note: Zero mobility and weak early. Kill him before 2 items. Don't let him reach W Bio-Arcane Barrage range - his DPS becomes unkillable.
Kog'Maw.key_mechanic: Bio-Arcane Barrage W - he scales to insane DPS with items. Aggressive early is mandatory.

Ashe.priority_note: Perma-slow makes her hard to escape once she's ahead. Her ult R Crystal Arrow global stun is a teamfight game-changer - always have escape up.
Ashe.key_mechanic: Crystal Arrow R - can come from off-screen. Keep enough distance that you can dodge it reactively.

Lucian.priority_note: Relentless Pursuit E makes him very mobile. Passive Lightslinger double-shot after each spell means his trades are always +1 free auto. Respect his burst pattern.
Lucian.key_mechanic: Relentless Pursuit E + passive proc - he dashes then immediately double-shots. Dodge the dash direction.

Samira.priority_note: Daredevil Impulse passive parries projectiles in melee range. Don't close into melee range voluntarily. Her Style rank S = R use - deny the style stacks.
Samira.key_mechanic: Flair E parry - she can block your projectile abilities with E timing. Deny her early stacks.

Nilah.priority_note: Melee range ADC - poke her for free from max range. She can't trade without dashing in. She excels in grouped fights; avoid those.
Nilah.key_mechanic: Jubilant Veil W dash - can leap to tagged allies ignoring terrain. Track her W CD before stepping up.

Twitch.priority_note: Ambush from Spray and Pray R angle is devastating - always ward river and brush. Weak without stealth setup. Punish his short auto range pre-items.
Twitch.key_mechanic: Rat-Ta-Tat R - ultra-long piercing autos. Stay at perpendicular angles to reduce exposure.

Kai'Sa.priority_note: Her power spike is tied to ability evolutions - she gets dramatically stronger at item thresholds. Watch her evolving - play aggressive before, defensive after.
Kai'Sa.key_mechanic: Killer Instinct R repositioning + passive Plasma stacks - she can close from long range on Plasma'd targets.

Aphelios.priority_note: Gravitum + Calibrum combo is his best engage. Track his weapon cycle - Infernum turret at objectives is map control. He's weaker during off-weapon rotations.
Aphelios.key_mechanic: Weapon rotation - Infernum AoE + Calibrum long-range snipe are his kill threats. Respect the slow-root combo.

Zeri.priority_note: Slippery - her E wall-hops make positioning hard. Poke when she's on cooldown. Punish E landing since it has a brief recovery.
Zeri.key_mechanic: Spark Surge (E) wall-hop - she'll hop terrain to escape or flank. Ward brushes beside lane so E angles are predictable.

Kalista.priority_note: Her passive hop makes her very hard to hit. AA-cancel her autos by stepping into her. Force trades when her spear count is low (0-1 stacks).
Kalista.key_mechanic: Rend (E) detonation timing - she waits for 4+ spears before E. If you can move away briefly between her autos, you reduce stack count.

Varus.priority_note: Long charge-up Q is his main poke tool. Sidestep at 0.5s into his Q channel - it's easy to dodge. Punish him after he misses.
Varus.key_mechanic: Chain of Corruption (R) roots and chains - separate from your support before R lands. Never stand adjacent to your support.

Corki.priority_note: Mixed damage - his Q and abilities deal magic damage through armor. Don't build armor early vs Corki; MR is more effective.
Corki.key_mechanic: The Package (Special Delivery) empowers his next Q for massive damage. He'll recall at 10min and come back loaded - respect it.

Senna.priority_note: She farms by collecting mist wraiths not minions. Low early DPS and CS. Punish her passive farming with aggressive all-ins pre-level 6.
Senna.key_mechanic: Absolution passive: mist wraiths give her range stacks permanently. Every fight she gets stronger. Kill her early before stacks accumulate.

Quinn.priority_note: Blinding Assault (Q) stops your autos entirely for 1.5-2.5s - cancel auto attacks immediately when blinded. Poke during her cooldowns.
Quinn.key_mechanic: Behind Enemy Lines (R) can engage from anywhere on map - not just lane. If she leaves, ping your team and track her immediately.

Akshan.priority_note: W (Going Rogue) marks you if an ally he's marked killed you. Grappleshot (E) hooks terrain for unexpected flanks - ward side brushes.
Akshan.key_mechanic: Comeuppance (R) long-channel damages you at 60% reduced damage while channeling. He can't dodge during R - all-in during his R cast.

Smolder.priority_note: Q gains stacks permanently - he gets stronger as game goes. Weak early (Q has 525 range). Punish him pre-50 stacks before Q upgrades.
Smolder.key_mechanic: At 225 Q stacks: execute on Q, heals on kill, bounces to adjacent enemies. Track his stack count - he becomes a different champion.

Zed.priority_note: Assassin bot - he'll ult you as ADC. Buy ISB second item always. Death Mark R marks you - Galeforce away BEFORE mark detonates.
Zed.key_mechanic: Death Mark detonation window is 3s after R lands. Use Galeforce dash or QSS immediately when marked.

Yasuo.priority_note: Double crit passive means he crits reliably at 2 crit items. Never stand in line with minions - Q tornado goes through them.
Yasuo.key_mechanic: Wind Wall (W) blocks all projectiles for 4s - he'll Wall your full combo. Wait for Wall to expire before using skill shots.
